svg.text: One customer request • direct response • no application document storage

svg.text: SEPARATE SUPPORTING DATA • NOT THE DOCUMENT CONTENT PATH

svg.text: SOLID BLUE file request • SOLID GREEN protected response • PURPLE optional OCR • DASHED AMBER / GREY quota and operations
Redaction policy applies to the existing engine. Unsupported or failed output checks stop the file release; customer decides whether to share the downloaded result.
